title: eMudhra intermediate CA key compromise: trust store still contains the affected roots
remedy: upgrade ca-certificates (USN-8944-1/2, DSA-6572, DLA-4845, RHEL 2026.2.92, Alpine 20261020-r0); no vendor fix available: prefix both entries with ! in /etc/ca-certificates.conf and run update-ca-certificates; rebuild container images

EMUDHRA-CA-2026.summary: eight eMudhra intermediate CAs (EM DV/OV/EV TLS CA - G3B/G3C, EM OV CS CA - G3B/G3C) were issued with recoverable private keys, so anyone can mint a certificate for any name; non-browser TLS clients do not check revocation, so a trust store containing either root accepts man-in-the-middle certificates

certs.name: AAA Certificate Services
certs.note: Sectigo legacy root; six of the eight intermediates are cross-signed under it, removing only the emSign root is not enough
